propositions: Rich-text encoding differs fundamentally between Jira Cloud (ADF JSON) and Data Center (plain text/wiki markup); today ADF is hardwired into Cloud path and duplicated when adding DC support

RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must preserve existing Cloud behavior where fit and normalize are composed separately by different callers
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py (not jira_family) to avoid violating import contract; WikiTextCodec lives in adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py
Single shared implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, taking RichTextCodec as dependency, with Cloud backend delegating to it
No new ADF references outside codec; existing location-pinned adf.py calls in outbound_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, inbound_differ.py remain unchanged
WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 chars) with marker " … [truncated by reconciler]", and codec contract must pass parameterized tests against both implementations
